fonttweaks.ui.title: FontTweaks 0.12.2 - Text Settings
fonttweaks.ui.desc.global: Basic text scale for menus and the in-game HUD.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.screen: Scale for menu, inventory and other screen text.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.hud: Scale for the in-game HUD text.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.button: Button labels only; button click targets are unchanged.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.chat: Scale for chat text, background and hit targets.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.global_line: Shared spacing multiplier for multiline text.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.blacklist: Excluded glyphs use their original fonts. Use the YACL list controls to add, edit, reorder or delete characters.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.letter_spacing: Change the horizontal space between glyphs. Zero is normal; positive widens; negative tightens. This is independent of line spacing. Text measurements, centering and wrapping follow the setting.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.english_exclusion: Keep English glyph tracking unchanged. English-only lines retain standard vertical spacing; lines with Japanese text use your configured line spacing.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.existing_font: Use a bundled font at this GUI scale: 3px selects Misaki Gothic 2, other sizes select PixelMplus12. OFF retains vanilla glyphs.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile_dots: Set dot size independently for each GUI scale (Auto or 1–4px). Start with a preset and switch to Custom for fine adjustments.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.presets: Selecting a preset immediately updates the GUI1, GUI2, GUI3 and GUI4+ option values. Editing an individual setting switches the preset to Custom. Save Changes commits the selection; Cancel discards it. Every preset disables English font replacement.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile.unifont_proce: Switch Unifont pixel processing on or off for this GUI scale only. Does not change the source textures of Misaki or PixelMplus.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile.replace_engli: Enable or disable Latin glyph and number font replacement at this GUI scale. All three presets use OFF.
